events.title: Renewed Consolidation Tipped For Malaysia Stock Market
events.description: The Malaysia stock market bounced higher again on Thursday, one day after ending the three-day winning streak in which it had gathered almost a dozen points or 0.7 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,635-point plateau although it's likely to turn lower again on Friday.

events.title: Losing Streak May Continue For Japan Stock Market
events.description: The Japan stock market has tracked lower in four straight sessions, sinking almost 3,600 points or 5.6 percent in that span. The Nikkei now sits just beneath the 61,080-point plateau and it's got another awful lead for Friday's trade.

events.title: AI Concerns May Continue To Drag KOSPI Lower
events.description: The South Korea stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last four trading days since the end of the two-day slide in which it had given up more than 280 points or 4.6 percent. The KOSPI now sits just above the 5,380-point plateau and it may extend its losses on Friday.

events.title: Japan Earnings Data On Tap For Friday
events.description: Japan will on Friday release September figures for average cash earnings, highlighting a light day for Asia-Pacific economic activity.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Ended Nearly Flat Amid Uncertainty Surrounding U.S. Moves To Resolve Iran Conflict
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value changed a little on Thursday, as investors assessed the possible measures the U.S. administration could adopt to end the Iran crisis as oil-linked inflation is attributed to be the prime reason for setback to Republican party in the just concluded mid-term elections.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Modestly Lower After Choppy Session
events.description:
The Switzerland stock market's benchmark index SMI ended modestly lower on Thursday after a choppy session, as investors stayed a bit wary of building up positions.

Weakness in U.S. and European markets amid a sell-off in the technology sector due to concerns about AI-related investments weighed on Swiss stocks.

events.title: European Markets Pare Early Gains, Close On Weak Note; Tech Stocks Tumble
events.description:
European stocks pared early gains and settled mostly lower on Thursday, as stocks from technology and financials sector tumbled on selling pressure. 

Tech stocks tumbled on concerns that a Democratic-led U.S. Congress could push for tighter regulation of AI development and data center construction, which could lead to a slowdown in capex.

events.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Dip, Match Multi-Decade Low
events.description: With the release of the more closely watched monthly jobs report looming on Friday, the Labor Department released a report on Thursday showing an unexpected decline in first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits in the week ended October 31st. The Labor Department said initial jobless claims fell to 189,000, a decrease of 6,000 from the previous week's revised level of 195,000.

events.title: U.S. Labor Productivity Surges More Than Expected In Q3
events.description: Labor productivity in the U.S. surged by more than expected in the third quarter of 2026, according to a report released by the Labor Department on Thursday.

events.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Fall To 189,000
events.description: With release of the more closely watched monthly jobs report looming on Friday, the Labor Department released a report on Thursday showing an unexpected decline in first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits in the week ended October 31st.

events.title: Canadian Stocks Poised To Rise On Commodity Strength
events.description: Canadian stocks are expected to move higher Thursday morning, supported by firm commodity prices and positive European market signals. Multiple companies report earnings, including Canadian Natural Resources, Bombardier, and Gildan Activewear, while investors await Friday's jobs data from Canada and the U.S.

events.title: Wall Street Likely To Open On Mixed Note
events.description: U.S. stocks are seen opening on a mixed note Thursday morning. Tech stocks are likely to be under pressure amid speculation the Democrats controlled Congress will possibly try to enforce greater regulation of the AI systems.

events.title: Bank Of England Lifts Interest Rate To 4%, First Hike In Over 3 Years
events.description: The U.K. central bank raised its key interest rate on Thursday, as expected, for the first time since 2023 in an attempt to cushion the future impact of the second-round effects of high energy prices and warned that more hikes would be necessary if the Middle East conflict does not resolve fast.
